item.title: USS Nimitz: U.S. Navy's oldest active carrier stops by San Diego on final journey
item.description: USS Nimitz, the U.S. Navy's oldest serving aircraft carrier which supported military operations in Iraq and Afghanistan, pulled into San Diego for the last time before being decommissioned.

item.title: 'It's deeply troubled right now': War in Iran sparks fears in California energy sector
item.description: People who work in California's oil industry, from the board room to the oil patch, hope that the war in Iran is ringing the alarm bell for policy makers in Sacramento. As gas prices soar, so do fears that the industry that powers the state may run out of fuel.

item.title: Open Door Network values 'publicity over ethical prosecution': Kern County District Attorney's Office
